{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793021321380,"sessionID":"ses_e879add22ffebnsn3iLSSD4cyQ","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_017wxJkA5KF2Hv2zx7LtSguQ","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/cholesky_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r3/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Parallel Cholesky decomposition (OpenMP, shared memory)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// The algorithm is a left-looking, column-oriented variant of the classic\n// row-oriented algorithm. For every column j:\n//   - L[j][j] is computed sequentially (a short reduction over k < j),\n//   - all L[i][j] for i > j are independent of each other and are computed\n//     in parallel. Each one uses the same reduction order over k as the\n//     sequential formulation, so the results are bit-identical to it.\n// Rows are processed four at a time so that four independent dot-product\n// chains are in flight per thread, improving instruction-level parallelism\n// without changing the summation order of any individual element.\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    double* const a = A.data();\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        double* const rowj = a + j * n;\n\n        // Diagonal element\n        double dsum = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            dsum += rowj[k] * rowj[k];\n        }\n        const double val = rowj[j] - dsum;\n        if (val <= 0.0) {\n            // Matrix is not positive definite\n            printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            return false;\n        }\n        const double d = sqrt(val);\n        rowj[j] = d;\n\n        // Off-diagonal elements of column j: rows i = j+1 .. n-1\n        const size_t first = j + 1;\n        const size_t rows = n - first;\n        const size_t blocks = rows / 4;\n        const size_t work = rows * j;\n\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (work >= 4096)\n        for (size_t b = 0; b < blocks; ++b) {\n            double* const r0 = a + (first + 4 * b + 0) * n;\n            double* const r1 = a + (first + 4 * b + 1) * n;\n            double* const r2 = a + (first + 4 * b + 2) * n;\n            double* const r3 = a + (first + 4 * b + 3) * n;\n\n            double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                const double lk = rowj[k];\n                s0 += r0[k] * lk;\n                s1 += r1[k] * lk;\n                s2 += r2[k] * lk;\n                s3 += r3[k] * lk;\n            }\n            r0[j] = (r0[j] - s0) / d;\n            r1[j] = (r1[j] - s1) / d;\n            r2[j] = (r2[j] - s2) / d;\n            r3[j] = (r3[j] - s3) / d;\n        }\n\n        // Remainder rows (at most 3)\n        for (size_t i = first + 4 * blocks; i < n; ++i) {\n            double* const rowi = a + i * n;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += rowi[k] * rowj[k];\n            }\n            rowi[j] = (rowi[j] - sum) / d;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Zero out upper triangular part (never read by the algorithm above)\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(guided)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        double* const rowi = a + i * n;\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            rowi[j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (inherently sequential RNG stream)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T (each element is independent)\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n\n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n\n    // Compute L * L^T (each element is independent)\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(max : maxError, relError)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    if (!success) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n\n    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/cholesky_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r3/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/cholesky_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_omp_r3/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","time":{"start":1793021321311,"end":1793021321342}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_17865ff65001TqmhJQzhiLRwi1","sessionID":"ses_e879add22ffebnsn3iLSSD4cyQ","messageID":"msg_17865d85a001Ua8C1buPvfpH7a"}}
